solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**₹24,075**).
solution.keyConcept: Reverse Annual Compounding: P = A / (1 + R/100)^2

optionTrick.en: Ratio factor over 2 yrs is $\left(\frac{6}{5}\right)^2 = \frac{36}{25}$. Divide 34,668 by 36 and multiply by 25 $= \mathbf{Rs.24,075}$!

steps.hi: मिश्रधन $P$ का 144% है $\Rightarrow P = \mathbf{Rs.24,075}$ सीधे प्राप्त होता है!

solution.en:
Method 1: Ratio-Multiplier Method (6/5): 1) 20% $= \frac{1}{5} \Rightarrow$ 1-yr factor $= \frac{6}{5}$, 2-yr factor $= \frac{36}{25}$.
2) $P = 34668 \times \frac{25}{36} = \mathbf{24,075}$ (**₹24,075**).

Method 2: Effective 2-Yr Rate (2R + R²/100): Notice $A$ corresponds to $144\%$ of $P$, so $P = \frac{34668}{1.44} = \mathbf{Rs.24,075}$!
solution.hi:

2) $P = 34668 \times \frac{25}{36} = \mathbf{24,075}$ (**₹24,075**)।

विधि 2: प्रभावी 2-वर्ष दर (2R + R²/100) ट्रिक: मिश्रधन $P$ का 144% है $\Rightarrow P = \mathbf{Rs.24,075}$ सीधे प्राप्त होता है!

solution.keyConcept: Direct Simple Interest (SI = P × R × T / 100)

Method 2: 1% Base × (R × T) Mental Trick: $1\%$ of Principal $= 6$. Multiply by $R \times T = 10$: $6 \times 10 = \mathbf{60}$.

question.en: Given that 94 0.8 = x, 94 0.03 = y and x z = y 2 , then the value of z is:
question.hi: यदि 94 0.8 = x, 94 0.03 = y और x z = y 2 है , तो z का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

solution.approach: Verified Answer: **0.075** ($z = 0.075 \approx 0.075$).
solution.keyConcept: Same Base Power Law: B^{p·z} = B^{q·k} ⇒ z = (q × k) / p

optionTrick.en: Ignore dummy base 94! Directly equate exponents: $0.8z = 0.03 \times 2 = 0.06 \Rightarrow z = 0.06 / 0.8 \approx 0.075$.
optionTrick.hi: डमी आधार 94 को छोड़ें! सीधे घात बराबर करें: $0.8z = 0.03 \times 2 \Rightarrow z \approx 0.075$।

title.hi: विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना

steps.en:
Substitute $x = 94^{0.8}$ and $y = 94^{0.03}$ into $x^z = y^{2}$:
$94^{0.8z} = 94^{0.03 \times 2} = 94^{0.06}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.8z = 0.06 \Rightarrow z = \frac{0.06}{0.8} = 0.0750 \approx \mathbf{0.075}$.

title.en: Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`)

solution.en:
Method 1: Base Substitution & Exponent Equating: Substitute $x = 94^{0.8}$ and $y = 94^{0.03}$ into $x^z = y^{2}$:
$94^{0.8z} = 94^{0.03 \times 2} = 94^{0.06}$.
Since bases are equal, $0.8z = 0.06 \Rightarrow z = \frac{0.06}{0.8} = 0.0750 \approx \mathbf{0.075}$.

Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`): Ratio of exponents $0.03 : 0.8 = 3 : 80$ ⇒ $z = \frac{3 \times 2}{80} = 6/80 \approx \mathbf{0.075}$.
solution.hi:
विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना: $x = 94^{0.8}$ व $y = 94^{0.03}$ को $x^z = y^{2}$ में रखें:
$94^{0.8z} = 94^{0.06} \Rightarrow 0.8z = 0.06 \Rightarrow z \approx \mathbf{0.075}$।

विधि 2: सीधा अनुपात सूत्र (`4 सेकंड`): सीधा $z = \frac{0.03 \times 2}{0.8} \approx \mathbf{0.075}$।

question.en: The cost of a washing machine is 50% less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by 81% and that of the TV decreases by 47%, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 4 washing machines and 3 TVs?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option B (**Increase by 4.2%**).
solution.keyConcept: Base-100 Unit Cost × Quantity Weighted Percentage Change

optionTrick.en: Set TV = `100` -> Machine = `50`. Total Weight $= 200 + 300 = 500$, Change $= +162 - 141 = +21 \Rightarrow \mathbf{4.2\%}$ Increase!

trapAlert.en: Remember to weight each unit cost by quantity (4 machines & 3 TVs) before computing net % change.
trapAlert.hi: केवल 1 इकाई का प्रतिशत नहीं बदलना है — क्रमशः `nW` मशीनों और `nT` टीवी की संख्या से गुणा करके भारित कुल निकालें।

title.en: Method 1: Base-100 Initial vs Net Change

methods.formula: $\%\Delta = \frac{n_W \cdot \Delta W + n_T \cdot \Delta T}{n_W W + n_T T} \times 100$

steps.en:
1) Let TV $= 100 \Rightarrow$ Machine $= 100 - 50 = 50$.
2) Old Cost of 4 Machines $+ 3$ TVs $= (4 \times 50) + (3 \times 100) = 200 + 300 = 500$.
3) Net change $= (+81\% \text{ of } 200) - (47\% \text{ of } 300) = 162 - 141 = +21$.
4) Percentage change $= \frac{21}{500} \times 100 = \mathbf{4.2\%\text{ Increase}}$.

Directly divide weighted percentage product sum by total base weights:
$$\frac{200(+81) - 300(47)}{500}\% = \frac{2100}{500}\% = \mathbf{4.2\%\text{ Increase}}.$$

solution.en:

2) $225 - 144 + 16 = 81 + 16 = \mathbf{97}$.

Method 2: a²−b² Identity & Unit Digit (4 sec): $(15 - 12)(15 + 12) + 16 = 3 \times 27 + 16 = 81 + 16 = \mathbf{97}$.
